# Search & Filter Core Logic Checklist: P-RF06 — Semantic search / filter

**Purpose**: Unit-test the quality of RF06's requirements for its riskiest, most novel mechanics — search debounce/request-supersession, the AND/OR filter-combination and multi-type merge logic, active-filter-chip/clear UX, and offline cache reconciliation — before `/speckit-tasks`.
**Created**: 2026-10-18
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the exact conditions under which a request is considered "superseded" (new search fires, filter changes, chip removed, Limpar filtros) fully enumerated, or could other triggers (e.g., app backgrounding, screen re-focus) leave the supersession rule under-specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005a]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the behavior specified for what happens to the in-flight-request tracking state when the user navigates away from and back to "Meus Registros" mid-flight? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements defined for how the merged multi-type result set's re-sort behaves when some per-type requests succeed and others fail partway through the fan-out? [Gap, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the number of simultaneous per-type requests (one per selected entry type, up to 4) bounded or otherwise addressed as a requirement? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements defined for how the "no results" state is distinguished when it results from a zero-match search term vs. a zero-match filter vs. the combination of both? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK006 Is it specified whether an active search term is ever represented as its own removable chip, or only sheet-originated filters are? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK007 Are requirements defined for how many active-filter chips can be shown at once when date range and multiple entry types are all active simultaneously? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the "isApplyingCriteria" loading-affordance requirement specified for every criteria-change entry point (search debounce, filter apply, chip removal, Limpar filtros), or only implied for search? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §FR-005a]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK009 Is "the most recently fired request" (FR-005a) defined precisely enough to resolve a tie when two triggers (e.g., a chip removal and a debounce elapse) occur in the same instant? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005a]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "re-sorted" (FR-003 / Key Entities) defined with the exact ordering rule for both the no-query (reverse-chronological) and active-query (relevance) cases, including a tiebreak rule for equal relevance or equal timestamps? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "scrollable from the local cache" (User Story 4, Scenario 1) clarified for whether scrolling an offline, already-capped search result list behaves identically to scrolling an offline filter-only (cursor-paginated) list? [Clarity, Spec User Story 4]
- [ ] CHK012 Is "reconciles with what the server currently returns" (FR-010) clarified as to whether an entry present in cache but absent from the fresh server response is removed from the displayed list? [Clarity, Ambiguity, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the exact user-visible wording of the "no results for this search/filter" state left unspecified, and is that gap intentional for this unit? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK014 Does the "AND across axes, OR within entry-type axis" rule (FR-005) cover the three-way combination (search + date range + multi-type) in terms consistent with the two-way combinations described in User Story 2 and the Edge Cases section? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK015 Is "same screen state" in the request-supersession rule (FR-005a) scoped consistently across its mentions in Clarifications, Edge Cases, and FR-005a itself — same criteria only, or any request on the screen regardless of criteria? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005a, Clarifications, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK016 Are the pagination-mode-switch rules (FR-005b: search active = one-shot bounded; search cleared = resume cursor pagination) consistent with how a filter-only multi-type merge (FR-003) is also described as a bounded, non-cursor result set? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, §FR-005b]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality / Measurability

- [ ] CHK017 Can "100% of currently applied filters are visible on screen as a chip" (SC-004) be objectively verified when multiple entry-type chips are selected — is that one combined chip or several, and does either reading satisfy the metric? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK018 Is "zero observed cases of an axis being ignored" (SC-003) measurable without a defined, finite set of criteria-combinations to test against? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK019 Is "after a period offline" (SC-006) bounded with any minimum/maximum duration, or is any offline period treated identically regardless of length? [Measurability, Ambiguity, Spec §SC-006]

## Scenario Coverage — Search Mechanics & Request Supersession

- [ ] CHK020 Are requirements defined for what the user sees between an in-flight search request being superseded and the newer request's response arriving (does the loading affordance persist, flicker, or reset)? [Gap, Spec §FR-005a]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the behavior specified when the user types, pauses long enough to fire a request, then resumes typing before that request resolves — is the eventual response from that first request still correctly discarded once a second one supersedes it? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-005a, §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK022 Are requirements defined for what happens if a debounced request fails (network error) after the user has already typed something newer — does the error surface for the stale failed request, or only for the latest one? [Gap, Spec §FR-005a, Edge Cases]

## Scenario Coverage — Filter Combination & Multi-Type Merge

- [ ] CHK023 Is the behavior specified when one of the N per-type requests (multi-select entry types) succeeds and another fails outright — partial merged result, full error, or something else? [Gap, Spec §FR-003, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK024 Are requirements defined for how de-duplication by entry ID (FR-003 / Key Entities) behaves if the same entry ID could appear in two different per-type responses with different `similarity` values? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-003, Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK025 Is it specified whether deselecting every entry-type chip (zero selected) is equivalent to "no entry-type filter" (all types) or to "match nothing"? [Gap, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK026 Are requirements defined for what "Aplicar" does when the user has made no changes to the sheet's selections since it opened? [Gap, Spec User Story 2]

## Scenario Coverage — Active Filter Chips & Clearing

- [ ] CHK027 Is it specified whether removing the last remaining sheet-originated filter chip (leaving zero sheet filters but an active search term) also removes "Limpar filtros" and the funnel's active state, or whether those persist because of the search term? [Gap, Ambiguity, Spec §FR-006, §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK028 Are requirements defined for the chip's label/content when multiple entry types are active (one chip per type, or one combined chip)? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK029 Is "Limpar filtros" (FR-007) specified to also reset the filter sheet's own internal (not-yet-applied) selection state, or only the already-applied, visible criteria? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]

## Scenario Coverage — Offline Cache Reconciliation

- [ ] CHK030 Are requirements defined for what happens if the device is offline when the user changes search/filter criteria, not just when already viewing a previously loaded list? [Gap, Spec §FR-010, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK031 Is the reconciliation behavior (FR-010) specified identically for the one-shot search result mode (FR-005b) as for filter-only cursor-paginated mode, given one has no further page to reconcile against? [Consistency, Gap, Spec §FR-010, §FR-005b]
- [ ] CHK032 Are requirements defined for how a cached entry that the server has since deleted, or that no longer matches the active criteria, is handled on reconnection? [Gap, Spec §FR-010]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK033 Is the behavior specified for a search term consisting only of whitespace (no printable characters)? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK034 Is a maximum search-term length specified, if any, before it is sent as `q`? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK035 Is the interaction between the session-expiry overlay (Edge Cases) and an in-flight, soon-to-be-superseded search/filter request specified — does the overlay's appearance itself count as a superseding or cancelling action? [Edge Case, Spec Edge Cases]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK036 Is the dependency on RF07's existing search bar/funnel button UI (Assumptions) traceable to RF07's actual shipped state rather than assumed purely from RF07's own spec? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK037 Is the assumption that search/filter state is not persisted across navigation (Assumptions) consistent with the session-expiry edge case's expectation that state survives a session-expiry overlay within the same screen visit? [Consistency, Ambiguity, Spec Assumptions, Edge Cases]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK038 Is there a conflict between FR-005b ("scrolling... MUST NOT trigger a further fetch" while search is active) and User Story 4's offline-reconciliation expectations when the device goes offline during an active search whose result list is already at its cap? [Conflict, Spec §FR-005b, User Story 4]
